items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: down comes Rollini, Adrian, and he said that he wanted to know the same thing, 'What are you guys going to do?' And he wants to take all the guys but he won't have Steve Brown.

ctx.x: Yes, enlarging it which I always liked to do, so I filled them all out. My God, I used the eight saxophones with a little bass in there. It was brutal, it was just like making a hog of myself with all these instruments. I was pigging it. So we spent about ten weeks that way, there were ten weeks before we come into Chicago and at that time we were going to have a recording date there, going to do some recording, so the time was not yet right to get tunes or anything. So, Jimmy had his car on the road and Curt…

And we went through a lot of college towns and it was in the fall, beautiful. And in the meantime, I didn't hear much from the guys in the band and I just figured they went their separate ways and that the most of them had gone with the New Yorkers with Adrian Rollini.
